# The arrival of a_usd_arrival_booked_to_the_directors_account.txt with its
# Canadian dollar split restated at 3,800.00 CAD, for `--strategy update`.
#
# The cost basis is priced at that split's amount over the 2,720.00 USD, so
# this re-prices it, and a cost basis a fee already draws on cannot be
# re-priced in place. The refusal says which split and which figure changed,
# and, since a transaction draws on the cost basis, lists it and prints the one
# command that deletes the two together.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
